blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The trough of the low-pressure area (LPA) outside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) may bring rain to Palawan, while three other weather systems are expected to affect parts of the country on Thursday, Nov. 26, the state weather bureau said. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) reported in its 5 a.m. weather advisory that the LPA’s trough may cause cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms over Palawan.
